sloka: अयं व्याघ्रसमीपे तु पुराणो धर्मसंस्थितः ।ऋक्षेण गीतः श्लोको मे तन्निबोध प्लवङ्गम ।। ६.११६.४३ ।।
transliteration: ayaṁ vyāghrasamīpe tu purāṇo dharmasaṁsthitaḥ ।ṛkṣeṇa gītaḥ śloko me tannibodha plavaṅgama ।। 6.116.43 ।।

translations.english: "Mighty Armed Hanuman! Do not speak in this manner. It was my fate which was supreme. Because of my predetermined circumstances I reaped such a result. I am feeblehearted and condone the maids surely."
